title: Current qualification and delivery state
summary: The sphere’s executable grounding is Legal Effect v0.14, Institutional Policy v0.8 and Intention Service v0.1-dev11. Legal Interrogation v0.1-dev5 passed standards/manifest/packaging qualification and was submitted through the canonical two-commit Alchemy Autobuild branch protocol; runtime acceptance was still pending at sphere-authoring time.
invariants: Legal Effect v0.14 is the accepted legal runtime baseline and continues to expose public API legal.effect/0.10.
Intention Service dev11 is the current dynamic-discovery baseline used by the adapter.
Legal Interrogation dev5 must not be described as runtime-accepted until an Autobuild receipt/result exists.
The Git submission branch is transport evidence, not acceptance evidence.

provenance.claim: Legal Effect v0.14 is the accepted runtime baseline used by this sphere.
Intention Service dev11 owns CLARIFY/CONFIRM/READY resolution, discovery-provider refresh/replacement semantics and discovery-generation stamping.
Legal Interrogation dev5 implements clause interrogation, proposition challenge, lifecycle invalidation and a real Intention Service dev11 discovery adapter.
Git submission branch contains the immutable two-commit Legal Interrogation dev5 Autobuild envelope; receipt was pending at sphere authoring time.
